entries.developer_comments:
~ Snippet in category 'local_files_simple'
~ This is extending the vanilla snippets belonging to mostly work of random
people: chat logs, SMSes, popular photos and videos that people share, or
something they can film by themselves.
identity:
hunternetlinda.mp4
Electronic music plays on a black screen.  Text appears on the screen
'Stand still, pause clocks, we can make the world stop'
A video montage follows a woman across multiple days and outfits.  On errands, at work, traveling in different cities.  About a minute into the montage of video there are short cuts to her violently attacking people in secluded settings.  Those gradually become the dominant images until it's only video of her feasting on the blood of her fallen victims.  The final image is her looking up; face covered, blood dripping down onto her ruined outfit; eyes staring straight into the camera as the image freezes.  On the now black screen, a name and address appear.
